name: Smoke Ladder
body:
School transmutation [fire]; Level legendary ninja 1, sorcerer/wizard 1

Casting Time 1 round

Components V, S, M (a smoke bomb or green wood)

Range touch

Target a ladder of smoke

Duration 1 min./level (D)

Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

You create a ladder made of smoke that can be up to 10 feet per caster level from the fire you touch. The fire can be of any size as the smoke forming the ladder does not consume the fire. Touching the fire in this manner does not damage the caster. It can be moved from its location, weighs next to nothing, and does not require a support. You can only have one smoke ladder active simultaneously. The ladder can support up to 400 lbs. on a particular rung. If the weight is exceeded, the creature or objects on the rung pass through but the rung reforms. Moving the ladder is a standard action that requires touching the ladder.
